content: Anatumi Mende Piru Lao Isaraele Wambu Dupwame Angiŋi Lao Ingyara Lao Soo Nyinya Lao Piya

content.text: Anatumi lao dopa leya.
Nakama yuu nanesa palaminyi dupwa nambana pii soo elya kalo karalapape.
Kote pii dupwana lalapale rapa rapa pyuo karalapape.
Nakamana pii laraminyi yuu gii doko sera ingilyamo dokona
api doko angi rolae larape lao lao semanale.
Apimi yanda pyuo anamasi minyingi akali doko neta potemenge dorena piso lanyuo epeyase?
Dee baa anja panda anja mendasa pelyamo dupwana baa wini pinya lao pingisi?
Apimi kiŋi akalipi yuu liti wakale wakale wambu dupwape nyuo amena lao porai renge mailyase?
Banya wua gela dokome nakama pyao mee sinjimu inginyi nembenge.
Banya walekya dupwame nakama pyao poo raiyame kalendakuna polo nembele lenge.
Baa minyaro nyelana makando peta papala range kyawa lete nyuo kimbu pyao piso penge.
Ama puu wakasa lao papala kimbu yukuna doko eketa rapu dokona palipae pilyasa yuu dokona angingyuo warenda nange.
Apimi dokona karapala yulu dopale dupwa pyaka sinya lao piyase?
Api mendeme wambo pyuo kaeyamo dupwana doko mende wamba piyaŋa lao soo giso lara ingiyase?
Namba Kamongo doko wamba enye kanda siyamo dokopa kareyo.
Dee namba Kamongo doko lumwa piramo dokopa dokona kararoko ingilyamo.
Yuu nanesa palenge wambu dupwame nambana yulu piyunu doko kando kaeyami.
Kando pakapala nakama walu walu lao pakame kumulyaminyi.
Dokona lao nakama nyuo malu palyapala imi.
Bange wasingi akali dupwame mendeme mende nyisalya nyisana pyuo rangeme porainyi pyambuo pingi.
Kamonda akalimi kana golome anatu ingyuo wasingi dokome au pyuo pipyalyamo, lenge.
Pena pena pinya lao wasingi akali dokome
akali mende pirimi pyao bange angi doko nyuo pyaso wasaramo doko kandokondali pyuo pinya lao porainyi pyambuo lara.
Dee nakamame lao, Yango kimbu soo wasisi doko keyange pipyalyamo lenge.
Lapala mee bange anatu kingimi wasisi doko pisarami panda dokona pirimi pyao rambu lao pisingi.
Dopa pyuo karaminyipape Isaraele dupwa nakama nambana kendemande wambu.
Nambana puu minying akali Aporakamena para pyasi dupwa
nambame nakama rombo palyuo nyiyu.
Nambame nakama emba yake yuupi lili rambungi dokona piso minyuo epeyo.
Nambame nakama yuu kyukunaiya kamame nanesa peteyaminyipa kee lao nyiyu.
Nyepala nakama langyuo lao, Nakama nambana kendemande wambuŋu.
Nambame nakama kilya kando mata jii napala nakama rombo palyuo nyiyu.
Namba nakama pipya role karapunu pilyamoŋo pakame kumuo kara nalapape.
Namba nakamana Anatuŋu bange mendemepe nakama keta paka mona palyinyi pyambwa nanale.
Nambame nakama porainyi pyambuo nyiso kararo.
Namba konambena mendeke alya isa ingyuo kyawa lete nyuo nyiso kararo.
Wambu lapome nakama pipya imbu singi manjarami dupwa
kingi isa paramopa pyao anamasi minyaraminyi renge doko soo nyerami.
Dee dopako pyuo lapome nakama pipya yanda pimwairami dupwa kumarami.
Dee isa yuu dakena mende laa nao mee opeape poko pana narami.
Namba nakamana Kamongo Anatu doko ingyuo karo.
Nambame porainyi pyambuo lao,
Nyisaroŋo dokona paka nalapape lapunu pilyamo.
Isaraele wambu dupwa nakama kuki ingyapala porai ingya napyamopape
namba nakama nyisaroŋo paka nalapape.
Namba Isaraele wambunya Anatu poo pyasi dokome nakama kyawa lete nyuo nyisiyu kande.
Nambame nakama isa warake dokona nenge pyao injingi dopale inginyi pyambwaro.
Isa warake dokona pirimi yale nenge karenge dupwa potemaro karara.
Nakamame yuu kyau dupwa pyao injo kokwa soo nembarami ingilyamo.
Yuu manda kuki dupwa inji ranji pyuo sinjimu inginyi nembarami.
Dopa pipala pyao yake dulunya nembaraminyipa
porambaiyeme soo pao
kopa apupi dokona raeyara.
Dokopa namba nakamana Anatu dokona nakama rae mairami.
Nakamame namba Isaraele wambunya Anatu poo pyasi doko lakandarami ingilyamo.
Nambana wambu dupwa bange ipwape yano pyaramopa nanapala ipwa kotarami dokopape
nakamana pendoko oo laramo ipwa nanarami dokopape
namba Kamongo dokome nakamana ateŋa doko isingi yano pyakamiru.
Namba Isaraele wambunya Anatu dokome nakama kame soo yaki nyii naro.
Nambame yuu kyau mende anda nange dupwana ipwa epena lao peyaronopa
dee yuu pau lama lama dorena ipwa guu lanyi peyaro.
Nambame yuu muiyane doko alowa pyuo ipwa pete sinya lao
dee yuu yando penda penda dupwana ipwa endangi palyuo epo karena lao piru.
Nambame yuu muiyane dupwana isa rara wakale wakale dupwa pulyuo andena lao piru.
Dopa pipala yuu mende anda nange dupwana ando imwa palira.
Paliramo dokona isa rara wakale wakale ando kararami.
Wambu dupwame doko kandapala
namba Kamongo Anatu dokome piilyamo lao soo nyerami.
Isaraele wambunya Anatu poo pyasi dokome
dopa pinya lao piyasa piyalyamo lao nakama soo gisarami.

content: Isa Kanapeme Wasapala Anatuŋu Lao Lakandenge Dupwa Kando Anatumi Pii Mende Lamaiya
Kamongo Isaraele wambunya kiŋi dokome dapa lara ingilyamo.

content.text: Wambu rara peparaena mee bange anatu dupwa nakamana pii dupwa minyuo epo peyalapape.
Nakamana apiyanda pyuo lenge pii dusipa yapapala minyuo ipupwape.
Dae epapala rengya apa pira lao dokona polo lalapape.
Laraminyipa yuu gii dokopa piralyamo lao namwa soo nyepala kararama ingilyamo.
Dokona nakamame kote pii lenge dokona wamba apa piyamo dupwana lao polo lamailapape.
Lamaipala renge angi aki lao dokona wapu lao langyuo pipwape.
Rengya mende piramo doko namwa langipwape.
Dokopa namwame nakama anatuŋu lao soo nyerama.
Yulu keyange lapo pyuope panda randa lapo minyuo epope pipwa.
Pipala namwa keta yamarangyuo paka mona manjinyi pyambwalapape, leya.
Lapala lao, Nakamape nakamame yulu pilyaminyi dupwa angi mende ingya napala mee ingyuo pelyamo.
Dee wambu lapome nakama kingi wapambupi lakao jilyaminyi dupwa kando ipyuo miku kasilyu.
Dokona lao nambame neta pyakaenge dorena range akali mende rombo palyuo kaeyapu.
Baa dulurena karo wambu palaminyi dupwa pinya lao lanyuo eparo.
Dokopa akali pee warame wasingi dokome banya kimbumi wara kalyuo injo pingi doko suu pyao
baame akali mupwa dupwa wara ingyuo kalyuo isa palyara ingilyamo.
Dokopa namwame kinyi emba kapa angi rolae dokona letene larami lao
nakama dokona api mendeme doo leto doko kinyi angi piraŋa lao lamisi?
Nakama mendeme dokona lao pii kuki mende laa nayami kande.
Nakama mendemepe pii kuki mendepe laminyi see nayami kande.
Namba Kamongo dokome wambo kanda soo yuu Sayone dokona pii wai nembeyo.
Nambame yuu Jerusaleme dokona pii minyingi akali mende nembo lao,
Nakamana wambu dupwa anda epelyaminyi lyakande leyo.
Nambame mee bange kingimi wasisi anatu dupwa kandapunu dokopa
dokona mendemepe mende larami ingya napya.
Dee kamame mendaki mendeme pii nambana piso sipunu dokona isingi yano pyakamarami ingya napyako.
Bange anatuŋu letaminyi dupwa mee ingyuo pelyamo.
Nakamame yulu mendepe pirami ingya nalyamo.
Mee bange isa kanapeme wasisi dapwa pyuku lasi nakama keta porainya renge mende pali nalyamoko, leya.
